race.comment: The big one of the day, which brings together a pretty handy field for a Murtoa Cup. PRINCE ERIC (3) is an import who has had a productive campaign. He disappointed the start after a good win at Caulfield and was put away and made an encouraging return in the Gold Nugget at Ballarat - which is a key form reference for this. He'll have come on for that and is suited back up to this trip. NAVY KING (5) has done little in two runs back, but was a force in some handy country cups this time last year and should be ready to show something. ASTRADEEL (7) is an absolute gun-wet tracker and his winning hopes rely on getting those conditions, but if he gets them he'll be in it up to his eyeballs. COVERT THINKING (8) has really hit top form her past two starts and is another who loves any give in the track. THE PENDRAGON (1) hasn't lived up to the early raps, but his Gold Nugget run was good and this looks a good progression.
